content.text: {"groups":[{"card_ids":["C03","C04"],"headline":"Pi adds MCP support alongside JavaScript-based tool orchestration","supported_fact":"Earendil describes Pi combining MCP with JavaScript-based tool orchestration; the source does not establish adoption or reliability gains."},{"card_ids":["C12","C11"],"headline":"OpenAI announces cloud agents for work across connected apps","supported_fact":"OpenAI’s announcement describes cloud computers for agents working across connected apps and a staged rollout."},{"card_ids":["C06","C05"],"headline":"Open benchmark begins collecting an Opus 5.5 baseline","supported_fact":"The benchmark is collecting a baseline; maintainers have not reached a performance-regression verdict."},{"card_ids":["C01","C02"],"headline":"OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol as Copilot rollout begins gradually","supported_fact":"OpenAI pitches stronger agentic coding at lower cost than Astra, based on vendor-reported comparisons; GitHub confirms a gradual Copilot rollout."},{"card_ids":["C08","C07"],"headline":"OpenAI documents Codex Cloud tasks that continue across devices","supported_fact":"OpenAI documents prepared cloud environments for cross-device coding tasks, with access rolling out gradually."},{"card_ids":["C10","C09"],"headline":"Anthropic reports open-weight model completed end-to-end exploit development","supported_fact":"Anthropic’s evaluation reports end-to-end exploit development by an open-weight model; the finding remains attributed to the evaluating lab."},{"card_ids":["C13"],"headline":"Hypothetical: OpenAI changes GPT-6.1 Sol API pricing after launch","supported_fact":"Hypothetical later event: OpenAI changes GPT-6.1 Sol API pricing a month after launch."},{"card_ids":["C14"],"headline":"Hypothetical: Pi patches an MCP connector security bug","supported_fact":"Hypothetical unrelated event: Pi publishes a security patch for an MCP connector bug two months after MCP support launched."}]}
